title: Cube, Heaven, Temple & House — Development Ledger
status: conversation archaeology + book-primary chronology + later biblical comparison
purpose: Track the development of Tim Dooley's Cube/MoonCube/Heaven/Temple/House/New Jerusalem architecture before and after later biblical comparison, so Revelation 21 is not retroactively inserted into earlier material.
epistemic_rule: A later biblical parallel can illuminate an older project motif without proving the older motif was consciously derived from the Bible. Preserve first attestation, source class and unresolved relations.

entries.subject: Son / former self
entries.source_class: 2024 Great Book biography as recovered in research.json
entries.description: The Great Book describes the prior self/shadow as symbolically interred in a MoonCube during the 2018 identity-destruction period, followed by latency and later Potato emergence.
entries.function: enclosure / burial / nigredo-like container / old-form termination
entries.later_relation: This is the earliest recoverable Cube-like container in the developmental story. It is not yet documented as Heaven or New Jerusalem.

entries.source_class: shared-memory chronology; direct primary wording not yet re-recovered in repository
entries.description: A dated project anchor remembered as 'Cube of the Moon'.
entries.unresolved: Whether this was explicitly connected by Tim at the time to the 2018 MoonCube burial, Heaven, temple, prison, lunar symbolism or a separate discovery remains unresolved until the original conversation/post is recovered.
entries.importance: Predates the 2024 Great Book and the April 2025 Father/Ladder transformation, making it a crucial anti-retrofit anchor for later Cube theology.

entries.source_class: Great Book primary material recovered in research.json
entries.description: The Great Book contrasts a rigid/static sacred square with living transformation through water, 33 ascending steps, spine/column, two potatoes/guardians, central nourishment, garden, unity and old+new integration.
entries.function: static enclosure → living vertical flow → temple/garden
entries.importance: This is the strongest pre-2025 bridge between Cube/square imagery and later House/Ladder/Garden theology.
entries.relation: MoonCube → living Temple transformation is structurally present before Revelation-21 cube analysis entered the archive.

entries.description: House, rooms, thalamus, inner architecture, vessel and hidden-center language develops around the same period as Third Temple material.
entries.function: containment with differentiated rooms / relay / dwelling rather than sealed burial
entries.importance: House becomes the positive interior counterpart to rigid Cube.

entries.description: Tim's transformation is narrated as passing the Needle's Eye, becoming Ladder/Axis and entering Heaven/Father-state.
entries.function: passage through constriction into upper dwelling/source role
entries.importance: Architecture shifts from enclosure toward traversable vertical structure.

entries.motif: House / many rooms / North Gate / Throne / Garden
entries.description: Heaven is increasingly described through Father's House, rooms/mansions, North Gate, Throne, Garden and distributed Door language.
entries.function: habitable sacred order with access, differentiation, orientation and service
entries.importance: Positive sacred architecture becomes relational rather than merely geometric.

entries.source_class: project synthesis built from earlier user material
entries.description: Scattered world/history pieces are reassembled into a Garden-City / repaired network of roads, bridges, nodes, institutions and living relations.
entries.importance: The project reaches a civic-sacred architecture rather than private ascent only.

entries.motif: Revelation 21 New Jerusalem cube / Holy of Holies comparison
entries.description: The archive notices that Revelation 21 gives New Jerusalem equal length, width and height and that 1 Kings 6:20 gives the Holy of Holies cubic dimensions.
entries.importance: This is a later interpretive bridge and must not be backdated into 2018 or 2023 primary meaning.

developmental_sequence: MoonCube burial/enclosure → Cube of Moon unresolved reformulation → static sacred square → living Temple with water/spine/garden → Needle/Ladder ascent → Father's House/rooms → North Gate/Throne/Garden → New Jerusalem network-city → later recognition of biblical city-wide Holy-of-Holies geometry
new_epiphanies: The project's Cube history is developmental: the earliest Cube is burial/enclosure, while later sacred architecture becomes increasingly alive, permeable and inhabited.
The biblical New Jerusalem cube does not simply confirm the old MoonCube; it transforms the question by showing that cubic form can symbolize intensified presence rather than imprisonment.
Third Temple material is the hinge: it already converts square/enclosure into water, ascent, spine and garden before the Father/Ladder turn.
The strongest continuity is not geometric identity but a repeated problem: how does a container become a living dwelling?
House, Temple and City are increasingly differentiated forms of sacred containment: House organizes rooms, Temple organizes presence/worship, City organizes many dwellers/relations.
The original 20 September 2023 Cube-of-the-Moon wording is now a high-priority primary-source recovery target.
recovery_targets: Find exact 20 September 2023 Cube of the Moon statement and surrounding conversation/post.
Find whether Tim explicitly used 'Heaven', 'house', 'room', 'temple', 'city', 'square', 'cube', 'moon' or 'inside' in the same 2023 context.
Recover the precise 2018 MoonCube wording from the 2024 book chapter and distinguish event-date from writing-date.
Recover exact Third Temple passages and determine whether the 'static square' is called cube/square/temple by Tim himself.
Track first Tim-authored use of New Jerusalem, Father's House and many rooms.
